description: Implementation of a JobThread class managing a worker thread with a message queue, including thread creation, priority setting, and run loop management.

classes.name: ThreadParam
classes.description: Helper struct to pass parameters to thread entry point, including thread name, priority, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: JobThread
classes.description: Manages a worker thread that processes jobs from a queue, including thread creation, priority setting, and run loop.

methods.name: JobThread::JobThread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes thread attributes, creates the thread, and waits until the job queue is ready.

methods.name: JobThread::~JobThread
methods.description: Destructor that schedules the thread to stop and joins the thread.

methods.name: JobThread::ThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Static method serving as the thread entry point, sets thread name and priority, initializes the job queue, and runs the loop.

methods.name: JobThread::RunLoop
methods.description: Runs the job queue until stopped and resets the queue.
